title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does the Moment Nobody's Checking on Him
caption:
9 things a godly man does the moment nobody's checking on him.

That's when you find out who's actually in charge.

He closes the tab before he tells himself he already lost. He puts the phone down at the same hour, even on vacation. He prays before he checks his phone in the morning.

Whoever is faithful in very little is faithful also in much (Luke 16:10). Integrity is just the stuff you do the same alone.

He finishes the workout he could've easily skipped today. Discipline you only do for an audience isn't discipline.

#faith #discipline #christianmen #manofgod #selfcontrol #integrity
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
